intentAndPurpose.intent: Circular identity mark. Text initials from alt (not OneUiText). Image mode requires src. Wrap in OneUiSurface.

forbids: text content at size 2xs or xs (widget demotes those to icon)

codeSnippets.title: Initials
codeSnippets.code:
OneUiAvatar(
  content: OneUiAvatarContent.text,
  size: 's',
  attention: OneUiAvatarAttention.medium,
  appearance: 'secondary',
  alt: 'Jane Patel',
)

codeSnippets.title: Photo
codeSnippets.code:
OneUiAvatar(
  content: OneUiAvatarContent.image,
  src: 'https://example.com/photo.jpg',
  size: 'l',
  attention: OneUiAvatarAttention.low,
  alt: 'Alex Brown',
)

props.name: content
props.description: image | icon | text. image requires src.

props.name: size
props.description: T-shirt size string, not sizeAlias. Text initials need s or larger (2xs/xs demote to icon).

props.name: src
props.description: Required when content is image. HTTPS or vendored asset path.

props.name: alt
props.description: Person name for initials (Jane Patel → JP) and semantics. Prefer this over fallback text.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Optional. Never OneUiText. Initials: omit and use alt. Custom letters: Text('JP').
